biotools.summary: DeconBenchmark is an R package and GitHub repository providing a benchmark of cellular deconvolution methods. It aims to facilitate the selection of appropriate deconvolution methods for researchers by providing a comprehensive review and benchmark, addressing challenges related to the numerous methods and lack of performance assessment.
